main_measure.name: mean next-bar return on forecast<0 bars minus mean next-bar return on all bars (BTC, pooled windows)
main_measure.threshold: in-state mean at least 0.10% per day below the all-bars mean with stretch-clustered t <= -2 (confirm); difference >= 0 (reject)

supporting_check.name: share of down bars in stretches minus share over all bars

decided_by: The difference is negative but t > -2, or it is smaller than 0.10% per day, or the down-bar share inside the stretches is not higher, so the confirm rule is not met.
reading: In-state bars are bars with forecast < 0 and a next-bar return inside the window; a stretch is a maximal run of consecutive forecast<0 bars within one window; the t is the in-state-minus-all-bars difference over the stretch-clustered (CR1, G/(G-1)) standard error of the in-state mean, treating the all-bars mean as the reference; the supporting check's pass is the down-bar share comparison the confirm rule names.
